valkey.condition: Authenticated channel publishing with cluster mode enabled; combined channel+message exceeds UINT32_MAX, >4GiB memory; script can bypass default512MB direct-argument bulk ceiling. Non-cluster servers explicitly unaffected.
valkey.impact: Heap overflow, reliable process crash, possible RCE.
